provenance: basis-construction oracle based on published AIACHNE basis geometry; no PFNS observations

reference_geometry.centre_spacing: equal in log10 energy over frozen domain

limits: Only basis and overlapping group structure are implemented.
No horseshoe prior, global tau hyperprior or Bayesian Monte Carlo sampler.
Feature group membership is supplied by the curator.

projection_example.note: The projected vector is supplied as delta(E) to the raw-scale PFNS bias likelihood.
